item_bragi_lyre_desc: A small plucked string instrument used by Viking skalds to accompany sagas and poetry. Based on lyre fragments found in Ribe, Denmark (8th century).
item_bragi_boneflute_desc: Carved from the leg bone of a deer. Among the most common musical finds from Viking-Age Scandinavia. A haunting, breathy tone.
item_bragi_jawharp_desc: A small iron instrument held against the teeth and plucked. Produces a buzzing, resonant drone said to induce trance states for seidr rituals.
se_skaldsblessing_tooltip: The music fills your spirit with energy. Stamina regenerates faster.
